ngaap.guidance: 2022 guidance REDUCED across all metrics (27-Oct-2022): Revenue ~$16.8B (vs. $17.3B - $17.7B, low end); organic revenue change down ~2.0% (vs. up 1.0% - 3.0%, low end); net income margin ~6.80% (vs. 12.00% - 12.25%, low end); segment operating margin ~15.50% (vs. 16.00% - 16.25%, low end); GAAP EPS $5.80 - $6.05 (vs. $10.75 - $11.05, low end); non-GAAP EPS $12.75 - $13.00 (vs. $13.35 - $13.65, low end); operating cash flow ~$2.2B ($2,225M; vs. $2.4B - $2.5B, low end); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.0B (vs. $2.15B - $2.25B, low end; R&D capitalization cash tax ~$600M vs. $600M - $700M). By segment: IMS ~$6.8B, down ~3.0% (vs. up 2.0% - 4.0%, low end), margin ~13.00% (vs. 13.50% - 13.75%, low end); SAS ~$6.0B, flat (vs. flat - up 2.0%, low end), margin ~12.00% (vs. 12.50% - 12.75%, low end); CS ~$4.2B, down ~3.0% (vs. flat - up 2.0%), margin ~24.25% (vs. 24.25% - 24.50%, high end). Other: net FAS/CAS pension adjustment ~$535M (vs. ~$540M; service cost ~(45), CAS ~(140), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~95, non-service FAS pension income ~440); net interest expense ~$275M (vs. ~$265M); integration expenses ~$75M; non-GAAP effective tax rate ~14% (vs. ~15%); average diluted shares ~193M; capex ~$300M. Reconciliation: revenue $16.8B; segment operating income $2,600M; unallocated corporate ~34; merger integration ~(75); amortization ~(605); goodwill impairment ~(802); acquisition and other divestiture related ~(45); legal, severance, sale of asset group ~(52); non-operating income, net ~(8); FAS/CAS pension adjustment, net ~535; net interest ~(275); income taxes ~(167); net income $1,140M. EPS: GAAP $5.80 - $6.05 + integration ~0.39 + acquisition/divestiture ~0.23 + amortization ~3.13 + legal/severance/asset group ~0.27 + goodwill impairment ~4.16 + non-operating ~0.04 - NCI ~(0.02) = pre-tax ~8.20; taxes ~(1.25); after-tax ~6.95 -> non-GAAP $12.75 - $13.00.
ngaap.notes: Segment operating income / margin (non-GAAP in total): sum of segment operating income, excluding unallocated items (unallocated corporate department expense, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, divestiture / impairment items, other items) and the FAS/CAS operating adjustment; from fiscal 2022 segments are charged CAS pension cost and the former 'pension adjustment' (which included non-service FAS pension income) is replaced by the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, with non-service FAS pension income in non-operating income (comparatives recast). Non-GAAP EPS: EPS from continuing operations excluding amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, divestiture-related gains/losses and expenses, impairments and other items, net of tax and the NCI portion; FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income are NOT excluded (remain in non-GAAP EPS). Adjusted free cash flow: net cash provided by operating activities less net additions of property, plant and equipment, plus cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs (and net cash paid for income taxes associated with business divestitures, where applicable). Non-GAAP effective tax rate: tax rate on non-GAAP pre-tax income. The FCF bridge in the release is for the quarter (three months); cf in this file is year to date. Q3-22: goodwill impairment ($802M; IMS 447, CS 355) is inside GAAP segment operating income and excluded from non-GAAP segment operating income / margin (652, 15.4%). New adjusting items this quarter: charges for severance and other termination costs (voluntary retirement plan) 29, charge related to an additional pre-merger legal contingency 31, acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses 10, and an $8M non-operating adjustment (equity method investment earnings). Non-GAAP EPS computed on 192.8M diluted shares (reported 191.3M excludes antidilutive awards). Taxes on adjustments (122). Net debt / adjusted EBITDA see letter.
